applies_to: Guidewire PolicyCenter 10.x / Guidewire Cloud / earlier on-premise
info_to_collect: Policy, term and job number of the failing change
Change effective date and effective dates of all later bound jobs
What was changed (driver, vehicle/VIN, coverage, named insured)
Exact error text, screenshot, user ID and time with time zone
Whether the job was approved / UW referral cleared; other policies affected?
category: Policy Processing > OOS Endorsements / Effective Dating
title: Prior-term, multi-term, cancelled-term or reversal OOS changes fail
symptoms: Internal server error fixing a prior-term OOS transaction
Cannot purge or update an OOS change on a cancelled renewal
OOS across several terms runs more than an hour
Reverse endorsement or reinstatement errors; policies out of sync after a cancellation batch
cause: The change rolls forward into renewed terms; each extra term multiplies the slices to re-rate. Cancelled or non-renewed terms restrict withdraw and purge. Reversals and reinstatements re-sequence later jobs.
diagnosis: Map the term chain and the status of every term
Identify any cancelled or non-renewed term
Check batch history for the cancellation job if several policies are out of sync
resolution: Apply the change term by term, earliest first
For a cancelled renewal, reinstate or rewrite first, or have L3 purge the stray job
permanent_fix: Rules that block OOS changes on cancelled terms with a clear message; performance review of multi-term roll-forward.
escalation: PC L3 Policy Transactions for purge or data fix.
